notes: BodyParts3D 'bone organ' (FMA5018) mesh names that are bones but are NOT game answers, so the catalog-integrity test can account for every GLB node. Names are lowercase with leading 'left'/'right' laterality, matching the BodyParts3D English-name convention. This list was written before the real GLB node list existed: it is a candidate list, not a verified one. The reconciliation agent should intersect it with the actual node names, drop entries that do not appear, and append any leftover unmapped node that is likewise not a game answer. Rationale by group: the six auditory ossicles are inside the temporal bone and invisible in a whole-skeleton view; sesamoids (other than the patella, which IS an answer) are variable in presence and number between individuals; the remainder are non-answer fragments, cartilages, or teeth that sometimes ride along in bone-adjacent concepts. Do NOT add the sternum parts here: the catalog maps slug 'sternum' to manubrium/body/xiphoid if BodyParts3D splits it. Likewise do not ignore ilium/ischium/pubis or hip bone — one of those two groupings is the real answer set.
